game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Well, a frozen village well: the hold guard must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Pipeline: Chain one function's output into the next to push firewood down a processing line.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Well: a frozen village well
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Well, repeat each round: Chain one function's output into the next to push firewood down a processing line. Each round, yeti raiders strike the wall banner, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the pipeline value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wall banner from yeti raiders in Frozen Well: keep the pipeline meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 80-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: pipeline drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 80-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Function Pipeline
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Function Pipeline' (Week 6 slot 5), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Frozen Well'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how pipeline changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Frozen Well.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 80 seconds while pipeline > 0.
